notes.title: Choose your nightmare – difficulty levels in Shadowless
notes.content:
🩸 Choose your nightmare 🩸
In Shadowless, you won't just be walking through darkness—you'll decide how deep you want to go.
You can now choose from three unique difficulty levels:

👶 Mom, hold my hand
For those who want to experience the story and explore the world of Shadowless without major obstacles.

😶 Things get worse
Recommended choice. Horror that gradually escalates and reality that cracks under pressure.

💀 Darkness f***s you
Your mind will be tested to the brink of insanity. Only for the brave who are not afraid of the last light going out.

Whichever path you choose, darkness will follow you.
The question is: will you survive it?
